extDescription.message: Checks larger images on web pages locally for AI generation and marks hits with an AI badge.

reason_synthid.message: Carries Google's invisible SynthID watermark according to the C2PA manifest.

reason_ai_generated.message: AI-generated according to the image metadata (IPTC/C2PA).

reason_ai_edited.message: Edited with AI according to the image metadata (IPTC/C2PA).

reason_novelai.message: Created with NovelAI according to the image metadata.

reason_invokeai.message: Created with InvokeAI according to the image metadata.

reason_stability_ai.message: Created with the Stability AI API according to the image metadata.

reason_grok.message: Created with Grok (xAI) according to the image metadata.

reason_ideogram.message: Created with Ideogram according to the image metadata.

reason_aigc_label.message: AI-generated according to the image metadata (Chinese labeling standard GB 45438-2025).

optionsThreshold.message: Model threshold for the AI badge

optionsThresholdHint.message: Lower values find more AI images but mark more real photos by mistake.

optionsCheckMetadata.message: Read AI labels from image metadata (C2PA, IPTC, generator parameters)

optionsCheckWatermark.message: Check image pixels for SynthID and similar watermarks

optionsShowScore.message: Show the probability in the badge

optionsAbout.message: All checks run locally in the browser. Images are never uploaded. The model can be wrong in both directions; treat the badge as a hint, not proof.

optionsShowChecked.message: Also mark checked unremarkable images and running checks

error_fetch.message: The image could not be loaded.

error_decode.message: The image could not be decoded.

error_unsupported.message: Image format or aspect ratio is not supported.

error_model.message: The model could not process the image.
